tools.name: templatesearch
tools.description:
Searches the 1C code template or some additional context for a given query.

Args:
    query: The search term or question in Russian, describing the desired functionality or some case

Returns:
    A formatted string with context or code. Each result is a bounded card
    carrying the template's **ID**, its description and as much of its code
    as the answer's byte budget allows; a card that could not carry the
    whole template says how much it left out. Call get_template with that ID
    for the whole source, which is never shortened.

outputSchema.description: Generic wrapper for non-object return types.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description:
Returns one page of 1C code templates (id, description), ordered by id.

The template collection is larger than one tool result can carry, so this
returns a bounded page and says where the next one starts. Template source
code is not included — use get_template to retrieve the full code.

Args:
    limit: How many templates to return, 1..200 (default 50)
    offset: How many templates to skip, 0 or more (default 0)

Returns:
    JSON object {templates, total, returned, limit, offset, next_offset,
    truncated}. `next_offset` is where the next page starts, or null when
    this page reaches the end. `truncated` says the collection did not fit
    in this response. When the collection is empty, {"message": ...}.

offset.description: How many templates to skip, 0 or more (default 0)

outputSchema.description: Generic wrapper for non-object return types.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description:
Returns a 1C code template by its ID, including the source code.

Args:
    template_id: Template identifier (numeric)

Returns:
    JSON object with fields: id, description, code

outputSchema.description: Generic wrapper for non-object return types.

tools.name: remember
tools.description:
Saves a text note to the project memory for later retrieval.

Args:
    content: Note text — a solution, observation, or important fact (minimum 5 characters)

Returns:
    JSON result: {success, message, id}. When the note was stored but the
    search index has not caught up, `success` is false while `stored` and
    `index_pending` are true and `id` names the note that exists — the write
    is durable and must not be sent again.

outputSchema.description: Generic wrapper for non-object return types.

tools.name: recall
tools.description:
Searches for relevant notes in the project memory by meaning (vector search).

Args:
    query: Search query — what you need to recall (in Russian or English)

Returns:
    Formatted text with found notes or a message indicating no results

outputSchema.description: Generic wrapper for non-object return types.

tools.name: plugin_state
tools.description:
Reports the state of the plugin subsystem.

Returns:
    JSON with, per plugin file: the hooks and tables it declares, the
    classification of each hook, whether each is enabled, the error that
    disabled it, its failure count and the time accumulated in it — plus the
    order the files run in, the current plugin epoch, the files that failed
    to load, and whether the stored collections hold rows indexed under more
    than one derived-state plugin set.

outputSchema.description: Generic wrapper for non-object return types.
